whyItMatters: Detects when an AWS RDS database instance is restored from a snapshot and configured to be publicly accessible via RestoreDBInstanceFromDBSnapshot where responseElements.publiclyAccessible is true. Adversaries can abuse this to expose a copy of a database to the internet and exfiltrate its contents.
